messages:
sandeep: Quick idea: run 3-4 minute "bell rounds" next Wed to hand out spot awards at desks. keep it very low-key — bell + thank-you card + tiny eco-confetti pouch. who can run a route?
tara: I can take West office route. prefer to do early afternoon (2pm). need names + desks by Mon noon.
eli: I can do APAC timezone handoffs but will ship kits to those remote. can we keep the kit contents identical across regions?
sandeep: yes identical. contents = handwritten card, enamel pin, small eco-confetti sealed pouch, sticker. tagged recipients can opt for desk pickup instead of in-person.
ops-bot: Reminder: taxable benefit reporting required for spot awards over $100. Please submit award amounts to payroll by end of day Tue.
tara: thanks ops-bot. sandeep — please confirm per-recipient award amount so I can include in the payroll sheet.
sandeep: standard $75 per person for this round. exceptions: manager-approved extras (list in sheet).
hana: i'll help with physical kit assembly Thu morning. count?
sandeep: planning ~28 kits (HQ + nearby flex desks) + ~12 remote shipouts.
eli: for APAC shipping, recommend using regional courier XpressCo. will post shipping cadence.
tara: route plan: 2pm start, 3pm wrap. volunteers: tara west, sandeep east, hana assembly, eli shipping. anyone to cover photos? keep consent minimal.
hana: i'll take the photos. will ask: "do you mind a quick team photo?" if no, respect privacy. will store consents on sheet.
ops-bot: Payroll cutoff reminder: entries must be in benefits-portal by Tue 9am PT to hit next payroll. Non-compliance delays tax forms.
sandeep: noted. hana pls tag the "payroll_export" column once you assemble kits.
hana: will do. i'll also add a "no-photo" checkbox.
eli: shipping checklist for remote kits:
```
- confirm address in sheet
- pack kit with protective seal
- include packing slip + consent checkbox copy
- select courier per country matrix
- scan label and paste tracking into sheet
```
tara: small budget note — local catering team can provide chocolate squares for HQ handoffs if budget ok.
sandeep: ok up to $50 for small treats. keep receipts.
hana: where to store the handwritten notes template?
sandeep: added a template in the doc (column H). copy/paste short reason (1 sentence). keep it personal but concise.
eli: shipping lead times: APAC 2-4 business, EU 3-5 business. aim to ship Tue morning.
ara: (from ops-bot) please ensure international customs forms are completed for non-standard items.
ops-bot: FYI: awards over $600 require 1099 reporting — ops team to flag if any single award crosses threshold.
sandeep: all under threshold for this round. final action items: 1) sandeep finalize recipients by Mon 11am, 2) hana assemble kits Mon morning, 3) eli prepare shipping labels Tue AM, 4) tara run HQ rounds Wed 2pm.
tara: confirmed. link to sheet (fill col F for "photo consent", col G for "pickup preference"): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BellRounds-Kits
hana: will post pack counts by Mon 5pm.
eli: will share courier matrix once addresses are in.
sandeep: please keep these moments low-key and local. thanks team! :clap:
